Variants.Content: Troesmis food, boats and markets sustain camps. More dependants increase grain, cooking and transport needs together; service rewards matter when they buy real food.

Troesmis food, boats and markets sustain Gothic camps. Traveling followers need real food from this production; valuables still require a buyer and exchange. More dependants require more grain, cookware and transport.
